title: Paper Towel Holder Stand 14.4-Inch Solid Brass | Venetian Bronze | Freestanding | Carolina | Allied Brass
short_title: Paper Towel Holder Stand 14.4-Inch, Venetian Bronze
description:
Keep paper towels within easy reach without using wall space—this freestanding paper towel holder keeps the roll upright and stable on your kitchen counter in Venetian Bronze, which presents deep, warm undertones with subtle golden accents, evoking European craftsmanship and timeless style.

Highlights:
- Venetian Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Pairs elegantly with matching Carolina hardware for refined warmth
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
- Coordinate your kitchen with the Carolina Collection for a matching Carolina look across your hardware
- Built for everyday use from solid brass with a durable designer finish

Specs & Installation:
- Collection: Carolina (traditional/classic styling)
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Freestanding; no assembly required
- Overall size: 6.5 in L x 6.5 in W x 14.4 in H (projection 6.5 in)
- Weight capacity: 5 lb
- Product weight: 4 lb
- Included: Paper towel holder
Multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
